$comment: Mod sets the compat workflow runs the suite against, one game launch each.
extraMods is a comma separated list of owner/repo:AssetPrefix:packageId, staged from
each repo's latest GitHub release by mod-ci's stage-mods action. Floating is the point:
a pinned dependency answers 'does the current HugsLib break us' about one old tag forever.
There is no checksum. What the action refuses instead is a zip containing path traversal,
an absolute entry or a symlink, because those survive a floating version and a sha does not.
A Workshop-only mod cannot go here: staging one needs Steam credentials the script
Backends live in ci.yml, not here. This file is only about other people's mods, so
baseline is the control column every other set is compared against.
Every set costs a full suite run, so keep this list short.
